consequences: No durable local checkout exists yet; a fresh clone (verified with --recurse-submodules) is the recovery path. The workspace model change needs a bitty-docs/umbrella AGENTS.md follow-up.
context: The workspace path $BITTY_WORKSPACE/bitty-plugins is a grouping directory holding four live plugin repositories with uncommitted changes and registered worktrees; initializing the new repository there would entangle active work.
decision_body: Create, gate, and push the new repository from /tmp/opencode/bitty-plugins; the durable workspace checkout is deferred until the grouping directory is retired.
title: Build and push from a /tmp checkout for the bootstrap

consequences: Metadata refresh is network-dependent and non-blocking; offline runs leave the index unchanged with a notice.
context: Registry entries must stay minimal and must not duplicate version/stars/dates; the store and future CLI must consume one artifact.
decision_body: scripts/sync-metadata.ts fetches bitty-plugin.toml (bounded, credential-free) and writes an optional metadata object into generated/registry.json; generate-index preserves it across regenerations and drops it for removed entries.
title: Derived manifest metadata lives only in generated/registry.json

consequences: Root devDependencies have no automated updates until the follow-up completes.
context: The bun ecosystem updater for this repository failed in its updater container on the first run.
decision_body: Ship dependabot.yml with github-actions updates only; track re-enabling bun in TODO.md. The npm updater stays excluded as known-broken.
title: Remove the Dependabot bun updater after a failed trial

consequences: Single source of truth; no duplicated JSON under app/; dev and build both require the committed artifact to exist.
context: The deployed store must fetch generated/registry.json as a static asset, and a second copy under app/public would drift from the committed artifact.
decision_body: app/vite.config.ts adds an inline bitty-registry plugin: it serves /registry.json from generated/registry.json in dev and emits it beside index.html as a bundle asset at build time; the build fails loudly when the file is missing.
title: Emit registry.json through a Vite plugin instead of committing a copy

consequences: No duplicate rendering or per-route build step; payloads are client-rendered and depend on Cloudflare applying the fallback only for non-asset paths.
context: Routes /plugins/<id>, /categories/<c>, and /authors/<a> are dynamic and the registry is fetched at runtime.
decision_body: Single Vite bundle with History API routing; app/public/_redirects declares /* /index.html 200 for Cloudflare Pages; documented in README.
title: Cloudflare Pages SPA fallback instead of per-route HTML

consequences: Fail-closed deployment with graceful degradation; a green run can still mean 'not deployed', which the summary states explicitly; re-run after provisioning.
context: plugins.bitty.run is newly registered; verification, the Pages project, and credentials may not exist yet, and pushes to main must not fail on unrelated work.
decision_body: deploy.yml preflight marks provisioned=false with a run-summary notice when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID are absent; the deploy step is if-guarded, the build still runs, and nothing deploys with partial credentials.
title: Skip deploy with a notice when Cloudflare credentials are absent

consequences: Registry entries cannot express cross-plugin dependencies yet; deterministic rejection replaces a confusing unknown-key error; README/CHANGELOG document the decision and the future authorization path.
context: Research R9: plugin manifests may declare [dependencies], but the registry has no dependency field and ENTRY_KEYS rejects the table as a generic unknown key. Option (a) would add optional registry dependencies {id: range} with version intersection and cycle detection; option (b) declares dependencies unsupported at the registry layer with an explicit error.
decision_body: Chose (b). A registry entry declaring [dependencies] is rejected with an explicit 'not supported in registry entries' error. Plugin dependencies stay in bitty-plugin.toml [dependencies]. The manifest-side pairing (rejecting [dependencies] in SDK/plugin validators) is a cross-repo follow-up, out of this slice.
rationale: Phase-1 scope and bitty-plugins AGENTS.md forbid inventing manifest/registry semantics: a registry dependency graph (intersection + cycle detection + index field) is a new cross-repository contract that must be separately authorized. A safe, minimal, discoverable rejection prevents an installer from seeing an unresolvable dependency.
title: R9: registry dependencies unsupported in phase 1 (option b)
